name: Dietrich
personality: Blunt, combat-hungry swordsman driven by revenge on a sea monster.
story: Great-grandson of the late matriarch Lamine (with a younger sister, Elfrida), shipwrecked in Dagda after the sea monster Cetus attacked his ship. He enters the Heroic Games seeking battle and revenge, hunting Cetus and ending Part I in an exhibition battle against Mars; his path digs into the setting's sci-fi backstory. Fabio travels with him as a healer-companion.

specials: Answerer: Hero's Relic, Mt 9, Wt 4, 20 uses, grants Bloodletting
Blaze Arts: Moving Shadow (Ch 4), Stifling Shadow (Lv 20), Ruinous Shadow (Lv 35). HP costs not documented; not usable in dungeon Clashes
Boost Combat Arts at Smyrnos's Temple (Dietrich's route only in Part I). Boost 10 different arts across the army to unlock Blacksmith for later paths
Teach Secrets (Ch 7) passes his Hidden arts to allies; they still need the right weapon type
Ink-Black Wen (personal accessory, Dex +5): where on this route: unknown
Bloodmark: Diadem of the Endless (heals on attack, 10%)
watch: Budget (swordfighter who doubles): extra weight on top of the sword ≤ 3. Sword 4 + Gale Ring 2 = 6 (extra 2); Killing Edge 6 + ring = 8. Fallback Archer's Ring 3: 7. Hunter's Ring (4) and Mars's Kneepads (5) break the budget.
If he stops doubling, swap to a 4-weight sword first: the Gale Ring's Spd +3 pays for its 2 weight. Zanbato (7) and Levin Sword (8) are situational: back to a 4-weight sword before enemy phase.
Part II: his Ch 12 inventory comes along (6 items?): Answerer Arisen, Gale Ring, Elixir, Concoction, then the Levin Sword +1 drop. Answerer Arisen keeps Bloodletting+.
6/6 in Ch 10 to 12: the Levin Sword swaps for the Concoction; at Mars the two Dews take the Silver Sword's (to Jester) and the Killing Edge's (storage) slots.
Weight (Part III): Da Mina Sword 4 + Gale Ring 2 = 6, extra 2 of 3, at +2 or +3. Levin Sword +3 (8) and Spearbreak Amulet (4) are swaps: the amulet comes off first.

decisions.why: Shido is the lord class for the Ch 12 solo duel with Mars. Myrmidon trains Sword toward Shido's Sword B, and he deploys every map, so he reaches Lv 35 first (about Lv 38 by the end of Part I).
decisions.else: Stay Shido through Part II; Sword Master in Part III needs Mars' Temple restored

decisions.topic: Keep his extra weight at 3 or less
decisions.pick: A 4-weight sword plus the Gale Ring (2)
decisions.why: Silver, Da Mina or Answerer Arisen (Wt 4) + Gale Ring = 6, inside his budget; Killing Edge (6) + ring = 8. The Hunter's Ring (Wt 4) is too heavy.
decisions.else: Archer's Ring if you have no Gale Ring yet

decisions.pick: Answerer Arisen, Gale Ring, Elixir, Concoction, Dew of Protection, Dew of Peace
decisions.why: Part 2 of the Ch 12 battle is Dietrich alone. Consumables share the 6 slots, so the Silver Sword goes to Jester and the Killing Edge, Levin Sword and Zanbato go to storage.
decisions.else: Answerer or your best 4-weight sword if Fabio's scenes didn't upgrade it
